excerpts: We present DeepSeek-V3, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated for each token.
Evaluation results on the ``Needle In A Haystack`` (NIAH) tests.  DeepSeek-V3 performs well across all context window lengths up to **128K**.
